SELECT BUYER, 'PR' GUBUN, LEGACY_PR_NO AS LEGACY_NO, REVISION, TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(ITEM_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_PRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PR_NO = #LEGACY_PR_NO# AND REVISION = #REVISION# GROUP BY BUYER, LEGACY_PR_NO, REVISION

SELECT BUYER, 'PO' GUBUN, LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_NO, REVISION, TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(ITEM_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND REVISION = #REVISION# GROUP BY BUYER, LEGACY_PO_NO, REVISION

SELECT BUYER, 'GR' GUBUN, LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_NO, REVISION, TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(GR_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_GRDT WHERE BUYER = NVL(#BUYER#,' ') AND LEGACY_GR_NO = NVL(#LEGACY_GR_NO#,' ') AND REVISION = NVL(#REVISION#,' ') GROUP BY BUYER, LEGACY_GR_NO, REVISION
